segments.text:
How great satisfaction must it be to all that
believe the Divine Authority of the Scripture,
that the faith•ulness of God stands engaged for
every line and syllable found therein? And how
many blessed lines in the Bible may we mark,
that respect even our outward concerns, and the
happy issue of them all? Upon these two grounds,
viz. that our outward concerns with their steddy
direction to a blessed end is •ound in the Word;
and this Word being of Divine Authority, the
faithfulness and honour of God stands good for
every Title that is found there. I say these are
grounds of such stability, that our minds may
repose with greatest security and confidence upon
them even in the cloudiest day of trouble.
Not only your eternal salvation, but your temporal
Interests are there secured. Be quieted
therefore in the confidence of a blessed issue.
